notes: DCA obligation was 221; borough calculated 142; settled with FSHC at 178 (April 8, 2025). Present Need = 0. Fourth Round VLA: RDP = 2 (from Block 1700, Lot 8). Unmet Need = 176 addressed via Zone D overlay and development fee ordinance. Third Round mechanisms still active: Block 1100/Lot 12 (Lakeshore Developers, 9 affordable, constructed), Block 1800/Lot 1 (Mass Ave/BCUW, 14 affordable, approved), Accessory Apartment Program (10 units), Block 1806/Lot 2 (Spectrum for Living, 6 affordable + 6 bonus supportive), Block 1008/Lot 1 (White Beeches overlay, unmet need), Zone D Overlay (unmet need). Recent Fourth Round completions: 160 Terrace Street (Block 1307, Lot 3) - 8 total / 2 affordable, CO May 21, 2025. Fourth Round RDP sites: 320 Haworth Ave (Block 1307, Lot 2) - 15 total / 3 affordable and 139 Terrace St (Block 1308, Lot 1) - 10 total / 2 affordable (Ordinance 2026-003, adopted March 10, 2025).
